description: NaAu(O₃I)₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.87 Å. Au is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Au-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.02 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two I atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (2.62 Å) O-I bond length. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.83 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.90 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.82 Å. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two I atoms. There is one shorter (1.83 Å) and one longer (2.62 Å) O-I bond length. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.92 Å. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Au, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.92 Å. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.84 Å. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.81 Å. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Au and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.91 Å. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.83 Å. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.82 Å. There are four inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. In the second I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. In the third I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. In the fourth I site, I is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms.
